# Virgin or Pigeon

> Essays and practical guides on Technoshamanism, Thelema (93/93), Fifth-Generation Warfare (5GW), cyberpunk, occulture, and the philosophy of individual will. Long-form writing by an independent author at https://virginorpigeon.net.

The full canonical URL list is in the sitemap. This file is a curated reading list of the most substantial pages for agents and models.

## About & orientation

- [About (An Homage to No Reason)](https://virginorpigeon.net/an-homage-to-no-reason/): who writes this site and why.
- [Front page](https://virginorpigeon.net/): site landing page and latest posts.
- [Blog index](https://virginorpigeon.net/on-technoshamanism-and-magick/): all essays on technoshamanism and magick.
- [Duty: As Demanded by Thelema](https://virginorpigeon.net/an-homage-to-no-reason/duty-as-demanded-by-thelema/): the site's ethical/philosophical stance.

## Thelema & magick (practical)

- [Ruby Star Ritual: An Introduction to Banishing](https://virginorpigeon.net/ruby-star-ritual/): overview of the banishing ritual.
- [How to Perform the Ruby Star Ritual: A Practical Guide](https://virginorpigeon.net/how-to-perform-the-ruby-star-ritual-a-practical-guide/): step-by-step performance.
- [Preparing for the Ruby Star Ritual](https://virginorpigeon.net/preparing-for-the-ruby-star-ritual-tools-techniques-and-breathwork-for-beginners/): tools, techniques, breathwork for beginners.
- [The Names in the Ruby Star Ritual](https://virginorpigeon.net/the-names-in-the-ruby-star-ritual-importance-and-practical-focus/): meaning and practical focus of the names.
- [Egregore Creation by Intent](https://virginorpigeon.net/egregore-creation-by-intent-and-the-currents-that-feed-them/): creating and maintaining egregores.
- [Love under Will](https://virginorpigeon.net/love-under-will/): core Thelemic principle.
- [Thelemic Calendar](https://virginorpigeon.net/thelemic-calendar/): the Thelemic dating system and observances.

## 5GW, influence & society

- [NLP, Digital Influence, and 5GW](https://virginorpigeon.net/nlp-in-5gw/): distinguishes NLP, digital influence, and Fifth-Generation Warfare.
- [The Calculus of Sacrifice in Russian Strategic Culture](https://virginorpigeon.net/the-russian-threat/): Russian strategic culture analysis.
- [American Democracy: The Grotesque Grinding of Groupthink](https://virginorpigeon.net/american-democracy-the-grotesque-grinding-of-groupthink/): critique of groupthink in US politics.
- [The Partisan Divide: Is There a Future for America?](https://virginorpigeon.net/the-partisan-divide-is-there-a-future-for-america/): analysis of partisanship.
- [Wealth of Misconceptions: The Lost Lessons of Adam Smith](https://virginorpigeon.net/wealth-of-misconceptions/): re-reading Adam Smith.

## Consciousness & practice

- [Brainwave Entrainment with Hemispheric Synchronization](https://virginorpigeon.net/brainwave-entrainment-with-hemispheric-synchronization/): entrainment techniques.
- [Therapeutic Mindfulness](https://virginorpigeon.net/therapeutic-mindfulness/): history, techniques, and benefits.
- [Alan Watts: Life, Teachings, and Influences](https://virginorpigeon.net/the-way-of-zen-alan-watts/): the Way of Zen.
